about_the_game:
We will be launching a crowdfunding campaign on May 14th, 6:15pm ET. Pre-Launch page out, follow us on Kickstarter! The future of PROJECT MIX depends on the crowdfund.

PROJECT MIX is a VR anime narrative game.

Set in the red light district of New Mong Kok, you play as Rone, a young former thug starting a new beginning to try to leave behind his life of crime. He unexpectedly becomes a bartender after a chance meeting with Valencia, the eccentric bar owner of Eleventh Heaven.

At first, you live by the paycheck working at Eleventh Heaven, but as you find yourself hearing a bit too much for your own good, you find yourself thrown into a deep conspiracy.

Key Features:

  • Meet unique characters and learn about New Mong Kok from differing perspectives.

  • Shake, pour, decorate, and serve. Interactive bartending mechanics built from the ground up for VR.

  • What you choose to serve changes the lives of your clients, and even the game narrative.

  • A focus on the small and subtle moments, such as having a smoke after work, sharing a drink, and petting your cat.

  • Explore the world through gorgeous and atmospheric environments featuring stylized anime visuals.

  • Interactive character moments and relationship building with detailed romance routes. Meet a variety of characters from all walks of life.

  • Original soundtrack tailored especially for the game, ranging from jazz, synthpop to citypop.

  • Different play modes supported. The game can be played comfortably seated or standing, and even in your bed if you dare so.

Non-VR Version

While our long-term vision is to build the leading VR anime/Asian game studio, we want as many people as possible to experience PROJECT MIX. If we can meet our funding stretch goals, we will definitely develop a non-VR version.

However, it won't be a basic first-person mode that any modder can throw together. Instead, it will feature completely redesigned controls, cinematic camera work, and tailored UI visuals, to more closely match what you may expect from Catherine or the Persona series. It will be a title that stands on it's own.

But it also means it will require extra time as well as skills we don't have, so the stretch goal funding will be essential.

content_descriptors.notes: There is strong sexual language, but any sexual content will be implied and not shown explicitly. Expect lots of suggestive and risque fan service elements though. There is alcohol drinking and bartending in the game. There is also smoking, but that is optional. The game is for mature audiences.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon 400 Series or better

  • VR Support: HTC Vive, Meta, Valve Index
